stories.title: Breaking down how the 17 first-year Power 4 coaches have done so far
stories.summary: After an unprecendented amount of change in 2025, let's take stock of how those new coaches are doing.

stories.title: Maryland fires Mike Locksley: Top candidates and roster priorities
stories.summary: After seven full seasons in College Park, Locksley is out, but the Terps have some notable pieces to build around.

stories.title: Goodell: NFL welcomes investigation into Eagles QB Hurts' medical care
stories.summary: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell said Wednesday that the league welcomes an investigation into the Eagles' handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clots.

stories.title: Saleh defends ex-Titan Elliott, says gun incident was not 'criminal act'
stories.summary: Titans coach Robert Saleh defended Jordan Elliott's character and said that last week's gun-related incident was "a call for help more than a criminal act."

stories.title: Sources: Warriors exploring options to trade center Porzingis
stories.summary: The Warriors have begun exploring trade routes for veteran center Kristaps Porzingis, who remains out indefinitely as he deals with a private health issue, league sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
